title: Mythos Session Note
description: Canonical frontmatter contract for LLM session notes mirrored into the Obsidian vault (Mythos-memories/transcripts/). Modeled on the richest existing example (hermes-session-2026-06-09.md) and expanded per amendment AMD-3 (memory-dreaming-obsidian-improvements__amendment__20260610T111449Z) with Actor Continuity Contract fields: session_id, parent_session_id, source_artifacts, termination_status, writer, schema_version, privacy_classification, human_operator, started_at, ended_at. Fields are required where mechanically determinable; otherwise they must be present and explicitly null (documented semantics below). Authored repo-side only — the vault is a one-way mirror.

type.description: Discriminator. Files without type: llm_session are not session notes and are flagged by lint as nonconforming transcript surfaces.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Bump on breaking frontmatter changes.

date.description: Session date (local), YYYY-MM-DD. Mechanically determinable — never null.

agent.description: Acting agent/harness identity (e.g. claude-code, hermes, pi, codex). Never null.

model.description: Model id (e.g. moonshotai/kimi-k2.5, claude-fable-5). null = not mechanically determinable from the source.

provider.description: Model provider/router (e.g. anthropic, openrouter). null = unknown.

platform.description: Interaction surface (e.g. cli, signal, discord, imessage, cowork). null = unknown.

scope.description: Project/scope the session served (e.g. system, personal, a client project name). null = unclassified; prefer setting it.

session_id.description: Harness session id (e.g. Claude Code session UUID). Required when the source carries one; null only for surfaces with no session identity (with a note in the body).

parent_session_id.description: Session this one was spawned from / resumed out of (cross-session continuation, subagent parent, bridge origin). null = root session or unknown lineage.

source_artifacts.description: Repo-relative or well-known paths this note was distilled from (session JSONL, debrief, handoff, signals). Empty array = hand-authored with no machine source.

termination_status.description: How the session ended. clean = explicit close (/end-session, /cross-session); handoff = closed via next-session/boundary handoff; daemon = long-running background session (no terminal end); active = note written mid-session; unknown = not determinable from source.

writer.description: Actor that wrote THIS note (may differ from agent — e.g. tools/transcripts/distill-session-note.cjs, hermes, human-operator). Never null.

privacy_classification.description: Session content classification, made by reading prose turns (never keyword counts — see jsonl-grep-counts-misleading). Gate key for the distiller (AMD-1): PERSONAL sessions are excluded from distillation by default; CLIENT:<code> notes must carry titles/paths only, no client data.

human_operator.description: Human operator who owned/ratified the session (e.g. {OPERATOR_NAME}). null = unattended/daemon session with no operator in the loop.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 session start. Required when the source carries timestamps; null = not determinable.

ended_at.description: ISO 8601 session end. null = not determinable, or termination_status is daemon/active.

time.description: Optional human-friendly time range (e.g. 13:29-19:42). Convenience only; started_at/ended_at are authoritative.

session_type.description: Optional legacy field (e.g. cli). Prefer platform.

tags.description: Vault tags. Must include 'session-transcript' for discoverability.

summary.description: One-paragraph plain-language session summary. Never null — a note without a summary is not a session note.

outcome.description: Terminal outcome / resulting state (Actor Continuity Contract: what is true now). null only when termination_status is active.
